about: Valuable entities for house.lost (VERIFY_HARDENING 6.4, 6.11; WP1): valuable when value >= min_value, when any of the flag fields is true, when it is a resident's personal belonging (personal_fields: a field naming a person who lives in the house; generation 2), or when its category, type or is_a is listed. house.lost fires for a valuable charged as removed (destroyed, or its content used up), and for ANY entity (valuable or not, unless it was waste at the baseline) whose charged final location chain reaches a loss class (loss_classes, location_classes.json) or whose relation is a loss relation; only envelope.deliver / consume or protections.off per entity excuse it, never envelope.move. A receptacle of a loss class is not its own refuse (the trash cart at the curb).
